body:
## Why

`ScriptViewHost::new` hardcodes `WindowCommandPolicy::Disabled`, and the only constructor accepting a policy is crate-private. A host that owns the top-level window and mounts a prepared view manually (instead of via `ScriptApplication::run\), cannot opt its embedded view into window commands — script calls like `ctx.close_window(...)` fail with `unavailable for embedded view` even though the host fully owns the window. Hit while porting tobi/disktree (disktree-rhai's `q` key).

## What

- `pub fn new_with_policy` + doc comment explaining when to use it. No behavior change; `new` still defaults to `Disabled`.

## Verification

`cargo test -p gpui-rhai --lib` green; clippy clean. (Policy behavior itself is unchanged — this only widens constructor visibility for external hosts.)
title: feat(app): make ScriptViewHost::new_with_policy public
